out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no hand soap at hand sink next to slushie machine.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM provided hand soap.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Observed residential pesticides can by mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CFM discarded residential pesticides.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the employee restroom.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. CFM to request purchase of covered trash can.
